summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 17, 2026 press release announcing redemption in full of USD 1,500 million 5.750% Perpetual Additional Tier 1 Contingent Convertible Capital Securities (CUSIP 456837AR4) on the November 16, 2026 call date, at principal amount plus accrued interest payable to holders of record November 13, 2026. The Bank of New York Mellon, London Branch, acts as paying agent. ING framed the call as capital-structure optimization, stating future call decisions will be made on an economic basis considering market conditions, regulatory approval and capital requirements. Watch for AT1 spread reaction and replacement issuance signaling.
